summary.text: Tim Twardzik is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2020, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 123, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as entrepreneur.

paragraphs.text: Tim Twardzik graduated from Shenandoah Valley High School in 1977 and earned a degree from the University of Notre Dame in 1981.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a businessman and entrepreneur.

Twardzik assumed office on December 1, 2020, and his 2023-2024 committee assignments, as listed by Ballotpedia, were Commerce (subcommittee chair on Economic Development), Health, and Urban Affairs & Housing (secretary).
